name: Spell Bonus Data
description: Custom spell power and attack power coefficients for direct and periodic (DoT/HoT) damage or healing of a spell, overriding the default coefficient calculation. Note: recent CMaNGOS WoTLK cores calculate coefficients internally and no longer read this table.

fields.name: Spell
fields.help: First rank of the spell, data applies to all ranks

fields.name: Direct Bonus
fields.help: Spell power coefficient for direct damage/heal, e.g. 0.428 = 42.8% of spell power

fields.name: Dot Bonus
fields.help: Spell power coefficient per tick of periodic damage/heal

fields.name: Ap Bonus
fields.help: Attack power coefficient for direct damage/heal

fields.name: Ap Dot Bonus
fields.help: Attack power coefficient per tick of periodic damage/heal
